0022600230.text: The Hornets (4-7, 1-3 on the road) visit the Suns (4-6, 4-3 at home) in their 12th game of the season, with Charlotte sitting 9th in the East and Phoenix 11th in the West, and both teams coming off a win. Charlotte is missing Brandon Miller (groin soreness), Dennis Schroder (hamstring strain), and Kon Knueppel (hamstring strain), while Phoenix will be without Mark Williams (shoulder surgery). The teams split their 2025-26 season series 1-1, and the Hornets won the most recent meeting 127-107 in Charlotte on April 2, 2026, with no games yet between them this season.
